jobs.title: Lead Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are: 
 
At Emburse, you’ll not just imagine the future – you’ll build it. As a leader in expense intelligence, we are creating a future where technology drives business value and inspires extraordinary results. Our AI-powered platform helps organizations modernize financial operations, increase visibility, and optimize spend across the enterprise.

What you will do :
- Data & Insights: Queries and synthesizes complex data, builds scalable reporting and dashboards, and translates findings into actionable recommendations for senior leaders.

- Process & Operating Models : Designs and improves scalable, cross-functional processes and operating models, driving alignment and adoption across teams

- Systems Thinking: Evaluates, implements, and optimizes product-management systems, including roadmapping, analytics, and project-management platforms

- Structured Problem-Solving: Independently turns complex, ambiguous problems into clear strategies, roadmaps, and execution plans, exercising sound judgment with limited precedent.

- AI Competent : Comfortable engineering new systems & tools with AI designed to meet user objectives and build data automations.

- Strategic Analysis: Leads analyses such as competitive research, pricing, customer segmentation, and opportunity assessment to inform product and business decisions.

- Stakeholder Leadership: Builds trusted relationships with senior and cross-functional stakeholders, resolves competing priorities, and generates buy-in without formal authority.

- Communication: Communicates complex ideas clearly and persuasively, producing concise, decision-oriented materials for senior audiences.

- Product & Software Expertise : Strong understanding of product management and the software development lifecycle, with the credibility to advise product, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams.
What we are looking for :
- Experience : 5+ years of relevant and progressively responsible experience, including ownership of complex or high-profile initiatives from definition through measurable results.

- Relevant Background : Experience in consulting; business, strategy, product, or revenue operations; or a related strategy and operations function.

- Software Experience : Meaningful experience in a software or technology environment, ideally partnering closely with product and engineering teams.

- Ownership & Independence: Operates with a high degree of autonomy, anticipates risks, resolves escalated issues, and remains accountable for outcomes with minimal supervision.

- Strategic & Hands-On: Moves comfortably between defining strategy and advancing the critical details required for successful execution.

- Influence & Change Leadershi p: Navigates organizational change with resilience, builds support for new approaches, and aligns stakeholders with differing priorities.

- Team Leadership: Serves as a trusted subject-matter resource and raises team effectiveness by sharing expertise, providing feedback, and coaching junior colleagues.

- Education : MBA preferred or business, engineering, or comp-sci preferred.
Why Emburse?
 
Finance is changing—and at Emburse, we’re leading the way. Our AI-powered solutions help organizations eliminate inefficiencies, gain real-time visibility, and optimize spend—so they can focus on what’s next, not what’s slowing them down. 
• A Company with Momentum – We serve 12M+ users across 120 countries, helping businesses modernize
 their finance operations.
• A Team That Innovates – Work alongside some of the brightest minds in finance, tech, and AI to solve real-
 world challenges.
• A Culture That Empowers – Competitive pay, flexible work, and an inclusive, collaborative environment that
 supports your success.
• A Career That Matters – Your work here drives efficiency, innovation, and smarter financial decision-making 
 for businesses everywhere. 
 
Shape your future & find what’s next at Emburse. 
 
Emburse provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Emburse complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location where the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Travel)
jobs.description:
Who We Are: 
 
At Emburse, you’ll not just imagine the future – you’ll build it. As a leader in expense intelligence, we are creating a future where technology drives business value and inspires extraordinary results. Our AI-powered platform helps organizations modernize financial operations, increase visibility, and optimize spend across the enterprise.


The Product Manager will shape the vision and delivery of our software products and analytics experiences. Partnering with clients and cross-functional teams—engineering, design, data/analytics, account management/sales, and marketing—the role translates user needs into clear requirements, prioritized roadmaps, and measurable outcomes. 
The Product Manager ensures analytics features (dashboards, reporting, data integrations) are accurate, explainable, and actionable setting success metrics and acceptance criteria to guide development. We seek candidates who demonstrate strong ownership, proactive problem solving, and the ability to anticipate next steps with limited direction. Flexibility to collaborate across global time zones is essential as we work with stakeholders in North America, Europe, and beyond.
 
**Please note we are NOT able to offer sponsorship now or in the future**

What you will Do
-
Own features across the entire lifecycle, driving product development with a full engineering and design team from concept through launch.

-
Collaborate on building business cases, defining the overall product vision and strategy, and actively participating in roadmap planning.

-
Internalize customer pain points to create clear, concise product specs, and write persona-based user stories and UAT scripts (covering Procurement, Finance, Travel Manager, and CSM).

-
Enforce release acceptance with a buyer lens, manage the prioritized feature backlog and bug process, and continuously test, iterate, and drive features to launch.

-
Partner with Product Marketing and Customer Success to ensure new features are well-positioned, effectively adopted, and supported across teams.

-
Partner with Engineering to prioritize and deliver automated regression tests, data contracts, and system monitoring, proactively expanding test coverage based on risk.

-
Define comprehensive metric specifications, strict guardrails (variance bands, freshness SLAs, null/duplicate thresholds), and a clear team Definition of Done.

-
Assist in identifying key product success metrics and track post-launch performance using product analytics and user feedback.

-
Maintain proactive communication regarding project status, milestones, and timelines with internal and external stakeholders.

-
Publish customer-grade documentation—including metric definitions, data lineage/caveats, and release notes—in close partnership with Technical Writing.

-
Test, gather insights, and refine features post-release to drive ongoing user adoption and platform value.
What you will Bring
-
Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, Business, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

-
6–10 years of experience in product, analytics, or data-quality roles, with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing analytics and reporting products.

-
Deep familiarity with corporate travel and T&E data workflows, including GDS, OBT, and TMC data flows, GL mapping, rate/tax handling, and PNR nuances.

-
Demonstrated experience defining and enforcing a clear Definition of Done, with the discipline to hold a strict "no-go" release stance when data guardrails fail.

-
Working SQL and BI literacy (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) to validate complex dashboards against source systems, alongside advanced Excel fluency and Microsoft Office proficiency.

-
Preferred ability to craft crisp product requirements, acceptance criteria, high-signal bug/issue reports, and buyer-centric UAT scripts.

-
Strong curiosity and customer empathy to frame problems from the end-user perspective, with the skill to separate signal from noise for high-impact decisions.

-
Excellent verbal and written communication skills to influence Engineering, CSM, and Tech Writing teams while delivering clear storytelling to executives and buyers.

-
A strong bias to action combined with high standards, keen attention to detail, and the confidence to hold releases ("not yet") until data integrity is fully verified.

-
Exceptional ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively, managing multiple high-priority, complex projects simultaneously and delivering clear work on time.

-
Solid understanding of modern team productivity tools, techniques, and cross-functional processes that enable teams to operate smoothly together.
Why Emburse?
 
Finance is changing—and at Emburse, we’re leading the way. Our AI-powered solutions help organizations eliminate inefficiencies, gain real-time visibility, and optimize spend—so they can focus on what’s next, not what’s slowing them down. 
• A Company with Momentum – We serve 12M+ users across 120 countries, helping businesses modernize
 their finance operations.
• A Team That Innovates – Work alongside some of the brightest minds in finance, tech, and AI to solve real-
 world challenges.
• A Culture That Empowers – Competitive pay, flexible work, and an inclusive, collaborative environment that
 supports your success.
• A Career That Matters – Your work here drives efficiency, innovation, and smarter financial decision-making 
 for businesses everywhere. 
 
Shape your future & find what’s next at Emburse.
